text:
maria.chen: FYI saw a spike in WS reconnects for tenant-42, looks like sticky routing fell back and caused KV cache misses + duplicate billing. Panic from customer.
nick: ugh. any obvious root cause? config change?
maria.chen: nothing in infra deploys, but console shows a routing policy flip to 'balanced' around 1702008700. That flip lines up with reconnects.
joel: was the flip part of the canary rollout yesterday? deploy-bot: deploy completed: routing-service v2.7.3 -> v2.8.0 at 1702008695 by ci/pipeline #2812 :shipit:
sre-oncall: we got multiple alerts for "session-lost -> new-session" in the same 10s window. traces show client resumed but got a different shard -> KV cache miss and then a full state fetch.
lucy: that would materialize as + token bill because resume falls back to cold path. Can we make resume idempotent across route changes?
nick: option 1: keep resume anchored to previous lease for X seconds to let resume succeed. option 2: make resume request carry previous route id and an allow-fallback flag that still tries original route first.
joel: prefer option 2. less global SLO impact. But we need console signals and quota rules to understand cost impact.
maria.chen: quick repro from curl (ws client log):
```
[ws] resume request -> 403
[ws] new connect -> routed to shard-B
[ws] resume -> KV cache miss -> cold fetch (~120ms)
```
sam: console currently shows only "resume_failed" and "new_session" events. We need richer telemetry: route_before, route_after, resume_attempts, kv_hit boolean.
lucy: agree. add a lightweight tag to the resume event so downstream billing can dedupe 1st token chunk if it's part of a resume race.
joel: open question: do we want billing dedupe at edge (proxy) or at router? edge would avoid double-ingress but router has authoritative session mapping.
nick: router-level dedupe seems safer: router sees both attempts and can mark tokens within a resume window as supressed for billing. But that requires tracing correlation id across reconnects.
marie.chen: (edit) maria.chen: also saw clients that retry with different client_id on reconnect, breaking correlation. We should document a recommended client behavior: reuse resume_token and client_id.
sre-oncall: short-term mitigation: revert routing-policy canary and force sticky affinity for 30m for affected tenants. Also add temporary metric alert for KV cache miss rate per tenant.
joel: I'll open a tiny RFC for resume-fallback header + router dedupe. Will include console UX: show "resume routed to old-shard? yes/no" per resume event.
lucy: can we also add a cheap console breakdown for billing anomalies showing "possible resume double-bill"? customers will want that.
nick: implementation plan: 1) telemetry tags (route_before, route_after, resume_id) 2) router dedupe proto (5% rollout) 3) console UI card + alert. I'll draft tasks.
sam: logged an internal ticket: INF-1123 resume dedupe telemetry and console card.
maria.chen: thanks all. reverting canary now. ping me if you need tenant-42 logs. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: rollback initiated: routing-service v2.8.0 -> v2.7.3 at 1702008920 by ci/auto-rollback
joel: thanks — we'll sync in eng-platform weekly to finalise RFC.
sre-oncall: keeping an eye on alerts, will escalate if KV miss rate doesn't drop by 90% in 15m.
